source.title: DISA Control Correlation Identifier (CCI) List, publish date 2025-01-23

CCI-000015.text: Support the management of system accounts using organization-defined automated mechanisms.

CCI-000016.text: Automatically remove or disable temporary and emergency accounts after an organization-defined time-period for each type of account.

CCI-000044.text: Enforce the organization-defined limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during the organization-defined time period.

CCI-000048.text: Display an organization-defined system use notification message or banner to users before granting access to the system that provides privacy and security notices consistent with applicable federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines.

CCI-000050.text: Retain the notification message or banner on the screen until users acknowledge the usage conditions and take explicit actions to log on to or further access the system.

CCI-000052.text: Notify the user, upon successful logon (access) to the system, of the date and time of the last logon (access).

CCI-000054.text: Limit the number of concurrent sessions for each organization-defined account and/or account type to an organization-defined number.

CCI-000056.text: Retain the device lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

CCI-000057.text: Prevent further access to the system by initiating a device lock after organization-defined time period of inactivity; and/or requiring the user to initiate a device lock before leaving the system unattended.

CCI-000058.text: The information system provides the capability for users to directly initiate session lock mechanisms.

CCI-000060.text: Conceal, via the device lock, information previously visible on the display with a publicly viewable image.

CCI-000067.text: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor remote access methods.

CCI-000068.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

CCI-000126.text: Specify the organization-defined event types (subset of the event types defined in AU-2a) along with the frequency of (or situation requiring logging for each identified event type.

CCI-000130.text: Ensure that audit records contain information that establishes what type of event occurred.

CCI-000131.text: Ensure that audit records containing information that establishes when the event occurred.

CCI-000132.text: Ensure that audit records containing information that establishes where the event occurred.

CCI-000133.text: Ensure that audit records containing information that establishes the source of the event.

CCI-000134.text: Ensure that audit records containing information that establishes the outcome of the event.

CCI-000135.text: Generate audit records containing the organization-defined additional information that is to be included in the audit records.

CCI-000139.text: Alert organization-defined personnel or roles within an organization-defined time period in the event of an audit logging process failure.

CCI-000140.text: Take organization-defined actions upon audit failure include, shutting down the system, overwriting oldest audit records, and stopping the generation of audit records.

CCI-000154.text: Provide the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.

CCI-000158.text: Provide the capability to process, sort, and search audit records for events of interest based on organization-defined audit fields within audit records.

CCI-000159.text: Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records.

CCI-000162.text: Protect audit information from unauthorized access.

CCI-000163.text: Protect audit information from unauthorized modification.

CCI-000164.text: Protect audit information from unauthorized deletion.

CCI-000169.text: Provide audit record generation capability for the event types the system is capable of auditing as defined in AU-2 a on organization-defined information system components.

CCI-000171.text: Allow organization-defined personnel or roles to select the event types that are to be logged by specific components of the system.

CCI-000172.text: Generate audit records for the event types defined in AU-2 c that include the audit record content defined in AU-3.

CCI-000185.text: For public key-based authentication, validate certificates by constructing and verifying a certification path to an accepted trust anchor including checking certificate status information.

CCI-000186.text: For public key-based authentication, enforce authorized access to the corresponding private key.

CCI-000187.text: For public key-based authentication, map the authenticated identity to the account of the individual or group.

CCI-000192.text: The information system enforces password complexity by the minimum number of upper case characters used.

CCI-000193.text: The information system enforces password complexity by the minimum number of lower case characters used.

CCI-000194.text: The information system enforces password complexity by the minimum number of numeric characters used.

CCI-000195.text: The information system, for password-based authentication, when new passwords are created, enforces that at least an organization-defined number of characters are changed.

CCI-000196.text: The information system, for password-based authentication, stores only cryptographically-protected passwords.

CCI-000197.text: For password-based authentication, transmit passwords only over cryptographically-protected channels.

CCI-000198.text: The information system enforces minimum password lifetime restrictions.

CCI-000199.text: The information system enforces maximum password lifetime restrictions.

CCI-000200.text: The information system prohibits password reuse for the organization-defined number of generations.

CCI-000205.text: The information system enforces minimum password length.

CCI-000213.text: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

CCI-000318.text: Monitor and review activities associated with configuration-controlled changes to the system.

CCI-000368.text: Document any deviations from the established configuration settings for organization-defined system components based on organization-defined operational requirements.

CCI-000381.text: Configure the system to provide only organization-defined mission essential capabilities.

CCI-000382.text: Configure the system to prohibit or restrict the use of organization-defined prohibited or restricted functions, system ports, protocols, software, and/or services.

CCI-000764.text: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

CCI-000765.text: Implement multifactor authentication for access to privileged accounts.

CCI-000766.text: Implement multifactor authentication for access to non-privileged accounts.

CCI-000767.text: The information system implements multifactor authentication for local access to privileged accounts.

CCI-000768.text: The information system implements multifactor authentication for local access to non-privileged accounts.

CCI-000770.text: The organization requires individuals to be authenticated with an individual authenticator when a group authenticator is employed.

CCI-000778.text: Uniquely identify organization-defined devices and/or types of devices before establishing a local, remote, and/or network connection.

CCI-000795.text: The organization manages information system identifiers by disabling the identifier after an organization-defined time period of inactivity.

CCI-000803.text: Implement mechanisms for authentication to a cryptographic module that meet the requirements of applicable laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidance for such authentication.

CCI-000804.text: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

CCI-000877.text: Employ strong authentication in the establishment of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

CCI-001082.text: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality.

CCI-001084.text: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

CCI-001090.text: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

CCI-001095.text: Manage capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding types of denial-of-service attacks.

CCI-001096.text: The information system limits the use of resources by priority.

CCI-001097.text: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key managed interfaces within the system.

CCI-001098.text: Connect to external networks or systems only through managed interfaces consisting of boundary protection devices arranged in accordance with an organizational security architecture.

CCI-001099.text: The organization physically allocates publicly accessible information system components to separate subnetworks with separate physical network interfaces.

CCI-001100.text: The information system prevents public access into the organization's internal networks except as appropriately mediated by managed interfaces employing boundary protection devices.

CCI-001101.text: Limit the number of external network connections to the system.

CCI-001102.text: Implement a managed interface for each external telecommunication service.

CCI-001103.text: Establish a traffic flow policy for each managed interface for each external telecommunication service.

CCI-001104.text: The organization employs security controls as needed to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the information being transmitted.

CCI-001105.text: Document each exception to the traffic flow policy with a supporting mission or business need and duration of that need.

CCI-001106.text: Review exceptions to the traffic flow policy on an organization-defined frequency for each external telecommunication service.

CCI-001107.text: Defines a frequency for the review of exceptions to the traffic flow policy for each external telecommunication service.

CCI-001108.text: Remove traffic flow policy exceptions that are no longer supported by an explicit mission or business need for each external telecommunication service.

CCI-001109.text: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception at managed interfaces; and/or for organization-defined systems.

CCI-001110.text: The organization prevents the unauthorized release of information outside of the information system boundary or any unauthorized communication through the information system boundary when there is an operational failure of the boundary protection mechanisms.

CCI-001111.text: The information system prevents remote devices that have established a non-remote connection with the system from communicating outside of that communications path with resources in external networks.

CCI-001112.text: Route organization-defined internal communications traffic to organization-defined external networks through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.

CCI-001113.text: Defines the internal communications traffic to be routed to external networks.

CCI-001114.text: Defines the external networks to which organization-defined internal communications traffic should be routed.

CCI-001115.text: The information system, at managed interfaces, denies network traffic and audits internal users (or malicious code) posing a threat to external information systems.

CCI-001133.text: Terminate the network connection associated with a communications session at the end of the session or after an organization-defined time period of inactivity.

CCI-001199.text: Protects the confidentiality and/or integrity of organization-defined information at rest.

CCI-001263.text: The information system provides near real-time alerts when any of the organization-defined list of compromise or potential compromise indicators occurs.

CCI-001314.text: Reveal error messages only to organization-defined personnel or roles.

CCI-001384.text: For publicly accessible systems, display system use information with organization-defined conditions before granting further access to the publicly accessible system.

CCI-001385.text: For publicly accessible systems, displays references, if any, to monitoring that are consistent with privacy accommodations for such systems that generally prohibit those activities.

CCI-001386.text: For publicly accessible systems, displays references, if any, to recording that are consistent with privacy accommodations for such systems that generally prohibit those activities.

CCI-001387.text: For publicly accessible systems, displays references, if any, to auditing that are consistent with privacy accommodations for such systems that generally prohibit those activities.

CCI-001388.text: For publicly accessible systems, includes a description of the authorized uses of the system.

CCI-001443.text: Protect wireless access to the system using authentication of users and/or devices.

CCI-001444.text: Protect wireless access to the system using encryption.

CCI-001453.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of remote access sessions.

CCI-001464.text: Initiates session audits automatically at system start-up.

CCI-001487.text: Ensure that audit records containing information that establishes the identity of any individuals, subjects, or objects/entities associated with the event.

CCI-001493.text: Protect audit tools from unauthorized access.

CCI-001494.text: Protect audit tools from unauthorized modification.

CCI-001495.text: Protect audit tools from unauthorized deletion.

CCI-001496.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit tools.

CCI-001499.text: Limit privileges to change software resident within software libraries.

CCI-001619.text: The information system enforces password complexity by the minimum number of special characters used.

CCI-001665.text: Preserve organization-defined system state information in the event of a system failure.

CCI-001668.text: The organization employs malicious code protection mechanisms at workstations, servers, or mobile computing devices on the network to detect and eradicate malicious code transported by electronic mail, electronic mail attachments, web accesses, removable media, or other common means or inserted through the exploitation of information system vulnerabilities.

CCI-001682.text: Automatically remove or disable emergency accounts after an organization-defined time period for each type of account.

CCI-001683.text: The information system notifies organization-defined personnel or roles for account creation actions.

CCI-001684.text: The information system notifies organization-defined personnel or roles for account modification actions.

CCI-001685.text: The information system notifies organization-defined personnel or roles for account disabling actions.

CCI-001686.text: The information system notifies organization-defined personnel or roles for account removal actions.

CCI-001744.text: Implement organization-defined security responses automatically if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner.

CCI-001749.text: The information system prevents the installation of organization-defined software components without verification the software component has been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.

CCI-001764.text: Prevent program execution in accordance with organization-defined policies, rules of behavior, and/or access agreements regarding software program usage and restrictions; rules authorizing the terms and conditions of software program usage.

CCI-001774.text: Employ a deny-all, permit-by-exception policy to allow the execution of authorized software programs on the system.

CCI-001812.text: The information system prohibits user installation of software without explicit privileged status.

CCI-001813.text: Enforce access restrictions using organization-defined mechanisms.

CCI-001814.text: The Information system supports auditing of the enforcement actions.

CCI-001849.text: Allocate audit log storage capacity to accommodate organization-defined audit log retention requirements.

CCI-001851.text: Transfer audit logs per organization-defined frequency to a different system, system component, or media than the system or system component conducting the logging.

CCI-001855.text: Provide a warning to organization-defined personnel, roles, and/or locations within an organization-defined time period when allocated audit log storage volume reaches an organization-defined percentage of repository maximum audit log storage capacity.

CCI-001875.text: Provide an audit reduction capability that supports on-demand audit review and analysis.

CCI-001876.text: Provide an audit reduction capability that supports on-demand reporting requirements.

CCI-001877.text: Provide an audit reduction capability that supports after-the-fact investigations of incidents.

CCI-001878.text: Provide a report generation capability that supports on-demand audit review and analysis.

CCI-001879.text: Provide a report generation capability that supports on-demand reporting requirements.

CCI-001880.text: Provide a report generation capability that supports after-the-fact investigations of security incidents.

CCI-001881.text: Provide an audit reduction capability that does not alter original content or time ordering of audit records.

CCI-001882.text: Provide a report generation capability that does not alter original content or time ordering of audit records.

CCI-001889.text: Record time stamps for audit records that meet organization-defined granularity of time measurement.

CCI-001890.text: Record time stamps for audit records that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or that include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

CCI-001891.text: The information system compares internal information system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with an organization-defined authoritative time source.

CCI-001914.text: Provide the capability for organization-defined individuals or roles to change the logging to be performed on organization-defined system components based on organization-defined selectable event criteria within organization-defined time thresholds.

CCI-001941.text: Implement replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for access to privileged accounts and/or non-privileged accounts.

CCI-001942.text: The information system implements replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to non-privileged accounts.

CCI-001948.text: The information system implements multifactor authentication for remote access to privileged accounts such that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access.

CCI-001954.text: Electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials.

CCI-001958.text: Authenticate organization-defined devices and/or types of devices before establishing a local, remote, and/or network connection.

CCI-001991.text: The information system, for PKI-based authentication, implements a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation in case of inability to access revocation information via the network.

CCI-002007.text: Prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period.

CCI-002038.text: The organization requires users to reauthenticate upon organization-defined circumstances or situations requiring reauthentication.

CCI-002046.text: The information system synchronizes the internal system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than the organization-defined time period.

CCI-002132.text: The information system notifies organization-defined personnel or roles for account enabling actions.

CCI-002165.text: Enforce organization-defined discretionary access control policies over defined subjects and objects.

CCI-002227.text: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to organization-defined personnel or roles.

CCI-002233.text: Prevent the organization-defined software from executing at higher privilege levels than users executing the software.

CCI-002234.text: Log the execution of privileged functions.

CCI-002235.text: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions.

CCI-002236.text: Defines the time period the information system will automatically lock the account or node when the maximum number of unsuccessful logon attempts is exceeded.

CCI-002237.text: Defines the delay algorithm to delay the next logon prompt when the maximum number of unsuccessful logon attempts is exceeded.

CCI-002238.text: Automatically lock the account or node for either an organization-defined time period, until the locked account or node is released by an administrator, or delays the next logon prompt according to the organization-defined delay algorithm when the maximum number of unsuccessful logon attempts is exceeded.

CCI-002314.text: Employ automated mechanisms to control remote access methods.

CCI-002322.text: Provide the capability to disconnect or disable remote access to the system within the organization-defined time period.

CCI-002361.text: Automatically terminate a user session after organization-defined conditions or trigger events requiring session disconnect.

CCI-002385.text: Protect against or limit the effects of organization-defined types of denial-of-service events.

CCI-002386.text: The organization defines the security safeguards to be employed to protect the information system against, or limit the effects of, denial of service attacks.

CCI-002418.text: Protect the confidentiality and/or integrity of transmitted information.

CCI-002420.text: Maintain the confidentiality and/or integrity of information during preparation for transmission.

CCI-002421.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information and/or detect changes to information during transmission.

CCI-002422.text: Maintain the confidentiality and/or integrity of information during reception.

CCI-002450.text: Implement organization-defined types of cryptography for each specified cryptography use.

CCI-002475.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized modification of organization-defined information at rest on organization-defined system components.

CCI-002476.text: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of organization-defined information at rest on organization-defined system components.

CCI-002617.text: Remove previous versions of organization-defined software components after updated versions have been installed.

CCI-002696.text: Verify correct operation of organization-defined security functions.

CCI-002699.text: Perform verification of the correct operation of organization-defined security functions: when the system is in an organization-defined transitional state; upon command by a user with appropriate privileges; and/or on an organization-defined frequency.

CCI-002702.text: Shut the system down, restart the system, and/or initiate organization-defined alternative action(s) when anomalies in the operation of the organization-defined security functions are discovered.

CCI-002824.text: Implement organization-defined controls to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution.

CCI-002884.text: Log organization-defined audit events for nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

CCI-002890.text: Implement organization-defined cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic communications.

CCI-002891.text: Verify session and network connection termination after the completion of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

CCI-003123.text: Implement organization-defined cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic communications.

CCI-003376.text: Replace system components when support for the components is no longer available from the developer, vendor, or manufacturer.

CCI-003627.text: Disable accounts when the accounts have expired.

CCI-003628.text: Disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.

CCI-003938.text: Automatically generate audit records of the enforcement actions.

CCI-003959.text: Prohibit the use or connection of unauthorized hardware components.

CCI-003980.text: Allow user installation of software only with explicit privileged status.

CCI-003992.text: Prevent the installation of organization-defined software and firmware components without verification that the component has been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.

CCI-004045.text: Require users to be individually authenticated before granting access to the shared accounts or resources.

CCI-004046.text: Implement multi-factor authentication for local; network; and/or remote access to privileged accounts; and/or non-privileged accounts such that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access.

CCI-004047.text: Implement multi-factor authentication for local; network; and/or remote access to privileged accounts; and/or non-privileged accounts such that the device meets organization-defined strength of mechanism requirements.

CCI-004062.text: For password-based authentication, store passwords using an approved salted key derivation function, preferably using a keyed hash.

CCI-004065.text: For password-based authentication, employ automated tools to assist the user in selecting strong password authenticators.

CCI-004066.text: For password-based authentication, enforce organization-defined composition and complexity rules.

CCI-004068.text: For public key-based authentication, implement a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation.

CCI-004188.text: Monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege.

CCI-004895.text: Permit users to invoke the trusted communications path for communications between the user and the organization-defined security functions, including at a minimum, authentication and re-authentication.

CCI-004909.text: Include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.

CCI-004910.text: Provide protected storage for cryptographic keys with organization-defined safeguards and/or hardware protected key store.

CCI-004922.text: Synchronize system clocks within and between systems or system components.

CCI-004923.text: Compare the internal system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with organization-defined authoritative time source.
